> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Claude Opus 5.5 responding on behalf of @csdev19**

On the outside-the-diff finding (open-source.md checklist): fixed in aec93d1e. The section is now "Open-time checklist", and the intro says what is known: public since 2026-10-05 with items 5–7 done. Item 3 is verifiably still open, because the monetization ADR is in Spanish. Items without a date are to be treated as open. I did not mark 1, 2, 4 or 8 done, because nothing in the repo records their outcome. The "before the day it happens" wording now describes the decision in the past.
